scope: Simplify the existing gameplay HUD and outcome screens after the UX review
features: Quick Race has no permanent generic goal; Career retains a compact exact pass target; goal remains available in Pause
Career intro no longer repeats its permanent target in a separate toast; free-session introduction lasts three seconds
Session, lap timing, minimap and vehicle instruments use smaller aligned authored rectangles; timing panel expands only for useful reference/status rows
Yellow outlined lateral chevrons replace proximity text without covering the car
Formula opponents receive fictional names; custom authored names and non-Formula defaults are preserved
Results use a leading outcome title, subdued performance metrics, and prominent actual credits/XP or livery rewards
Zero reward panels and unchanged XP progress are hidden; valid-finish rewards remain visible even when a career target is missed
Free-session success emphasizes lap performance; repeated Personal Best metadata is removed
Retry/Next Event focus, race rules, receipts and progression remain with existing owners
TMP Ellipsis row height fixed at 115 percent; acceptance checks now require visible glyphs for every active nonempty label

validation.input: Real RCCP keyboard movement; virtual gamepad Start pause/resume and input prompts
validation.accessibility: HUD and result variants checked at 115% text and 95% safe area; rendered label glyphs checked and screenshots reviewed at both resolutions
validation.raceCoverage: Real four-car Racing Visuals scene, RTG solo Time Attack, one-lap Shakedown retry and subsequent career time target
validation.scriptedBoundaries: RPM, checkpoint comparisons, physical rival positions, career finish receipts and result variants are scripted; not a natural race completion test
validation.outcomeVariants: Invalid lap, missed time with nonzero rewards, P4, free-session failure and Personal Best success, and career success with bonus and livery unlock
validation.saveIsolation: Temporary validation save; no QA rewards written to the player profile
validation.compilation: No C# compiler errors found; both final graphical Editor play runs captured no errors

areaMeasurement: Authored rectangular panel area, including standings; not a performance measurement. Temporary notices, pause control and conditional chevrons excluded.
limitations: No standalone build or physical Switch test for this revision
Measured race-time gaps are not part of the local overlap indicators
Only the current-session valid best lap supplies checkpoint comparisons
